headline.caveat: IREN's purchase of NVIDIA GB300 systems and related equipment from Dell to serve its $9.7B/5-yr Microsoft GPU-cloud contract at Childress, TX.

realized_to_date.caveat: Deliveries phase through 2026 alongside the Microsoft ramp; paid amounts not broken out (partly funded by Microsoft's ~20% prepayment and equipment financing).

nature_md: IREN agreed to buy ~$5.8B of AI hardware — NVIDIA GB300 rack systems and supporting equipment — from Dell to build out the GPU fleet serving its $9.7B Microsoft cloud contract at Childress, Texas. A textbook link in the money chain: Microsoft's compute dollars (with ~20% prepaid) flow through IREN into Dell hardware revenue and onward into NVIDIA content — one contract generating recognized revenue at three levels of the stack.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: IREN capitalizes the GB300 fleet as PP&E depreciated over the contract life, financed by the Microsoft prepayment, equipment financing/debt, and equity — a leveraged bet that the 5-year contract outlasts the hardware's competitive life.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Dell books ISG hardware revenue on delivery within its AI backlog; IREN is among the named customers (with CoreWeave, xAI) behind Dell's $24.4B of Q1-FY27 AI orders.
